error_reason: At step 10, the Orchestrator directed distance calculations among a fixed list of bars without first verifying wheelchair accessibility, conflating proximity with accessibility. This anchored the search on unverified candidates; the final selection (12 Steps Down) was made solely on distance with no confirmed accessibility. If accessibility had been verified or the set filtered first, the closest among truly accessible venues would have been chosen, preventing the incorrect final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: The Orchestrator instructed the WebSurfer to determine distances among a preselected list of bars from earlier search results without first verifying that those bars are actually wheelchair accessible. This conflated two requirements (closest and wheelchair accessible) and anchored on candidates without validating accessibility. Had accessibility been confirmed first (or candidates filtered to only wheelchair-accessible venues), the subsequent distance work would have been on the correct set, preventing the incorrect final answer.
